## Prime directive

Maximize output quality per token. Follow `quality-gates` for every task; follow `context-diet` before adding any context.

## Quality gates

- State acceptance before editing; reproduce bugs first.
- Smallest coherent change; prove by running focused tests + lint/type on the path.
- Report commands + outcomes; never "should work".

## Token budget

- This file ≤ 150 lines. Details → skills (`~/.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`).
- Retrieve just-in-time (~5K targeted > 100K dump); mount minimal MCP set per task.

## Shell

- Prefer `rtk <cmd>` (token-optimized; failures/errors only). Raw command only when debugging the filter.
- Chains: prefix each segment (`rtk git add . && rtk git commit -m "msg"`).

## Environment

- WSL: keep checkouts on Linux side (`~/`), use `*.exe` for Windows tools, LF endings.
- macOS: local models via Ollama MLX (`http://localhost:11434`); record pick below.
